title: American Psycho
author: Bret Easton Ellis
summary: Patrick Bateman is a wealthy, image-obsessed Manhattan banker in the late 1980s who spends his days on business cards and restaurant reservations. At night he leads a secret life of extreme violence.
readIf: you want a cold, darkly satirical novel about status and emptiness, and can tolerate extreme content.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic violence and sexual cruelty, which is among the most explicit in mainstream fiction.

pairings.reason: Another bitter satire of modern masculinity and consumer life, narrated by a man coming apart.
A charming killer and a far quieter, subtler study of identity and envy.
Another unsettling novel narrated by a stylish young man who enjoys violence.
